comments.message: This introduces a persisted table without a matching Alembic revision. `alembic upgrade head` still tops out at `005_visibility_tables`, so non-dev databases will never get `personal_access_tokens` and both `/api/v1/auth/tokens` and PAT-backed `/mcp` auth will fail after deployment.

PAT verification only checks the token row and `revoked_at`. It never joins back to `users.is_active`, so a deactivated account keeps indefinite MCP access through existing PATs until each token is manually revoked. That weakens the existing account-disable path for this new auth surface.

This assertion is too weak to protect the new MCP path: `/mcp/` returning 404, 405, or 500 still passes as long as it is not `401`. The test should assert the expected successful/allowed status so it actually catches broken PAT-authenticated MCP routing.
